text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Tail oil's checked off too. Didn't forget anything, so time to head back to the academy――

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Wait, that's from my hometown...!
Wah, they're having a local fair...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, maybe I'll go take a peek.
There's still time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And also—just because it's local goods,
I gotta make sure not to buy too much again!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This butterfly-shell keychain was handmade by kids from the elementary school I graduated from!
...I'll buy one as a keepsakeâª

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This dried fish is from my uncle's place!
I wonder if he'd be surprised if I sent him a photo of me eating it...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah! A new local T-shirt!
I don't think I've seen this towel before either...――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spotted Daring Tact walking around
with a shopping basket full of items.
choice_data_list: Oh, you're buying a whole bunch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Seriously, when did this happen...?!
At this rate, they're going to overflow from the shelf again...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for calling out to me.
Yeah, this really is way too much, so I'll cut it down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Which one should I put back?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: If I have to cut something, maybe the simmered whelk...? I still have some left over from last time anyway...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, yes. It's delicious.
The elderly lady next door makes it for me all the time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Whenever I'm out running, people stop me and hand me huge jars full of tsukudani.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was saltier than the store-bought kind.
...Yet I loved it so much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I'm just going to buy them all after all.
I don't think I can choose just one.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Anything about to overflow... I'll manage somehow with my organizing skills!
choice_data_list: Your hometown really is where you get all your energy, huh.
Your hometown really is where you get all your energy, huh?
I'm kind of curious, so maybe I'll buy one on my way home too.

text_block_list.text: Anything about to overflow... I'll manage somehow with my organizing skills!

I'm kind of curious, so maybe I'll buy one on my way home too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... The strength of one's hometown is truly immense.
Far greater than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ever since leaving my hometown,
I've come to feel that way even more strongly.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...I need to work much, much harder!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ! In that case, allow me to show you the way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
...It's a truly beautiful place, surrounded by nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I would be delighted to introduce them!
